summary: George W. Aldrich II, 28, a Snowmass lift operator, went missing the night of Saturday, Nov. 27, 2010 after exiting a bus at the wrong stop in Truscott and setting out on foot in the dark; his body was recovered Monday, Dec. 13 in a snowy depression beneath the new Maroon Creek Bridge on Highway 82 near the Aspen entrance, found by three Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers days after the Pitkin County Sheriff's Office suspended official field operations; accident, no foul play suspected
location: Maroon Creek Bridge, Highway 82, near Truscott / Aspen entrance
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Aspen Police Department
notes: Date = night he went missing (Sat 2010-11-27, weekday-verified); body recovered ~2:30 p.m. Mon 2010-12-13 (weekday-verified) by 3 MRA volunteers, days after PCSO called off official field operations (12-day search with Incident Management Team, planes/helicopters, dogs; missing-person report filed Nov 29, search began Nov 30). Challenge Aspen memorial bench plaque in Snowmass dates death 11-27-2010. Exact mechanism unanswered; found under the new bridge's center section, partially covered in snow.
